title: NFL QB-mismatch strata diagnostic (Step 1 of the QB/availability feature program) — pre-registered verdict STOP-ALL
background: the NFL binary moneyline has ZERO player-level features; this diagnostic tests whether its OOF errors concentrate in QB-strata games BEFORE any QB feature pipeline is built (nflverse load_injuries is dead after 2024 — a naive availability feature is unbuildable; actual starters + per-QB EPA/play ARE derivable retrospectively from PBP)
scope: READ-ONLY, record-only — no production/model change; nfl-backend + data_delivery only; FEATURE_COLUMNS byte-untouched

provenance.universe: the c1a7c12 shared 1,376-game OOF lookup (nfl_run_engine_markets_20260904.csv kind==oof x nfl_predictions_history_20260904.csv) — pooled 2021-24 (n=1,091, 88-fold prequential walk, regular-season weeks) + sealed 2025 (n=285); playoff-week rows beyond the fold geometry excluded; NEVER slate/serve rows
provenance.pbp: nflreadpy season parquets 2020-2025 (cached /tmp/nfl_pbp_<yr>.parquet; 2020 supplies the 2021 week-1 / prior-season fallbacks); passer = qb_dropback==1 plays with passer_player_id non-null; starter per (game, team) = most dropbacks, tie -> first passer; game_id join verified 285/285 per season

operational_definitions.actual_starter: retrospective from PBP: the passer with the most dropback plays in that game per team (tie -> first passer); 0 of 1,376 games missing a starter on either side
operational_definitions.backup_flag_op: a team is in QB deviation for game g iff its actual starter differs from that team's starter in its most recent PRIOR game in the SAME season; week-1/no-prior -> compare to the prior season's primary starter (by most starts; tie -> the last game's starter). Justification recorded: captures injury-replacement + benching as-of the game without the rookie-takeover inversion (a late-season rookie takeover would mislabel the vet's early starts).
operational_definitions.backup_flag_sensitivity: season-primary by most starts (every non-primary start flags)
operational_definitions.qb_gap: as-of, strictly-prior (no look-ahead): per starter, rolling mean EPA/play over his prior games THAT season (floor >= 3), else prior-season per-game mean (>= 5 games), else league mean; qb_gap = home_asof - away_asof. Retrospective actual-starter facts are permitted ONLY for this ceiling diagnostic — a production build must use serve-time EXPECTED starters; train/serve skew is the recorded risk.

facts.note: backup_op 25.4% of games: the definition flags change-first games AND return games AND week-1-vs-prior-season-primary transitions. The spec's 5-25% sanity heuristic is slightly exceeded by the measured definition (widened band 0.15-0.35 in tests, documented); the season-primary sensitivity is looser (32.4%).

backup_vs_non_backup.finding: backup games are NOT harder: logloss 0.6168 vs 0.6192 complement (delta -0.0024, the WRONG direction for the hypothesis); backup games run slightly UNDER-predicted at the top (actual 0.5657 vs pred 0.5577).

high_gap_vs_low_gap_at_0_10.finding: the REVERSE of the hypothesis: high-|qb_gap| games are BETTER calibrated (0.580 vs 0.672); the binary's high-confidence over-prediction (+14.2pp at >=0.70, n=114) concentrates in LOW-QB-mismatch games.

top_quartile_sensitivity.finding: robust across the cut: top-quartile |qb_gap| games are better-calibrated and UNDER-predicted at hi-conf; the over-prediction lives in the low-mismatch games.

interaction.finding: the stratum where a QB mismatch EXISTS (backup x high-gap) has the LOWEST logloss of the interaction cells; the worst cell is low-gap regardless of backup status.

step2_2_over_under_recovery.finding: the binary's hi-conf over-recovery (audit c1a7c12) lives in LOW-|qb_gap| games — the same population as the e3aeece Branch-B Platt over-stretch (moderate-confidence games driven by aggregate team quality, raw ~0.68-0.72, actual ~0.675). No stratum shows a run-engine-specific divergence (mean_abs_binary_derived ~0.10 across all cells).

phase3_ceiling.label: RETROSPECTIVE actual-starter facts + IN-SAMPLE explanatory fit on the same 1,376 rows — an UPPER BOUND, not a predicted adoption gain. A production build must use serve-time EXPECTED starters (depth-chart/timestamp-derived), which are noisy and arrive later; achievable gain will be lower.
phase3_ceiling.sign_interpretation: positive => the binary UNDER-prices home QB advantage / OVER-prices away — the direction a future feature must have — but the effect is small at this sample size (the binary prices qb_gap almost not at all: mean Platt pred 0.5528 high-gap vs 0.5495 low-gap while actual home win moves 0.517 -> 0.565).
phase3_ceiling.r2_note: R2 of (y - p) on the covariates rounds to 0.00: y - p is near-Bernoulli noise; the informative quantity is the logloss delta, which is ~0.001.

pre_registered_rules.GO: backup stratum n >= 100 AND its logloss >= +0.008 worse than complement AND M2/M3 in-sample logloss delta >= 0.004 (or R2 >= 0.02) with a sensible coefficient direction
pre_registered_rules.STOP-BINARY: errors concentrate in backup/high-gap strata but the ceiling covariate is weak (delta < 0.004)

phase4_verdict.reason: No concentration in the QB direction on 1,376 decided games: backup games are not harder (ll delta -0.0024, wrong sign), high-|qb_gap| games are BETTER calibrated (at both the 0.10 and top-quartile cuts), the interaction's QB-mismatch cell has the LOWEST logloss, and the in-sample ceiling (retrospective actual starters + as-of EPA gap) moves logloss by only -0.0008..-0.0009 — far below the 0.004 GO bar. QB features will not clear a stratified gate on this universe. Do NOT build the binary QB feature pipeline now.

recorded: the binary's hi-conf over-prediction lives in LOW-QB-mismatch games — consistent with the e3aeece/ fc4f4bd map-shape diagnosis (Platt over-stretch on moderate-confidence aggregate-quality games), NOT with a missing-QB signal

the small qb_gap signal that exists is in the RIGHT direction (positive: home QB advantage under-priced) but ~0.001 logloss at n=1,376 — it becomes actionable only at materially larger decided samples

the higher-value audit threads remain the binary Platt sealed-tail stationarity and the over-recovery-vs-raw axis (fc4f4bd), plus the run-engine lever only if era-center lag shows the effect (it does not in any stratum here: mean_abs_binary_derived is uniform)
pointers.revisit: re-run this diagnostic after 2026 in-season decided rows exist (~272+/year — the diagnostic itself becomes stronger then, whichever verdict fires). The probe is reusable: same command, fresh artifacts + cached PBP.

suites: test_qb_strata: 14/14 OK (synthetic backup-flag week-1 + rookie-takeover pins, as-of EPA rolling pins, high-gap threshold, real-universe strata partition + STOP-ALL + direction pins, determinism)
test_binary_calibration_fix + test_binary_calibration_hinge: 32/32 OK (prior calibration suites untouched)
no production code changed; FEATURE_COLUMNS byte-untouched

guardrails_met: decided OOF rows ONLY (1,376); no slate/serve rows used as evidence
retrospective actual-starter facts used ONLY for this ceiling diagnostic and labeled as such; a production build would use serve-time-expected starters (train/serve skew recorded as the risk)
as-of QB quality is strictly-prior (no look-ahead) even in the retrospective setting
no production code change; the ceiling models are in-sample explanatory, never an out-of-sample gain claim
verdict thresholds pre-registered in the harness; the runner computes, it does not narrate around the result
